instances.claim: This tells me that something in the work had been pulling the cent out of physical existence — dissolving it into idea, image or pure value — and that the draft has already described that pull.
instances.why: "Remained" and "buoyed into physicality" are both contrastive: they presuppose a stated force working against the object's persistence as a thing. Lines 1–4 establish only a price gap and two superlatives about commonness and reproduction; nothing before line 5 puts the object's physical existence in question, so the sentence pushes against a state of affairs the draft never sets up.

instances.claim: This tells me that CENTS consists of a defined, countable group of cent-objects, fixed in membership, which were all identical at the moment they entered the work.
instances.why: "Every Cent" and "Each object, initially identical" are claims about a bounded population, but the draft only ever names singulars and kinds — "a simple value discrepancy", "the readymade he chose", "the object". No line introduces an edition, a quantity, or a group whose members could be compared to one another, so both quantifiers range over a set the draft never constituted; line 19's "initially identical" in particular is a comparative claim with nothing to compare.
